text:
alex: Quick sync: SDK PR #420 needs API change from redwood-api#88. If API merges first, SDK tests break until we cut a compat branch. Can we schedule merges so console/runtime not impacted?

sana: Do we need a feature flag or can SDK be tolerant? I can review the API change today if there are no blockers.

liam: Console depends on the new /models/meta field — backend change is in the API PR. If API merges first, console must be bumped. I'll hold console PR until SDK + API are aligned.

alex: Proposed plan: 1) Merge API into canary branch 2) run e2e in staging (helm: redwood-runtime v2.4.1 -> v2.4.2) 3) SDK cut compat branch and release patch 4) roll console. @deploy-bot can we schedule a staging deploy after API merge?

deploy-bot: noted: enqueue deploy; ETA ~30m after merge, will run smoke tests.

nidhi: Heads up: Dedicated infra has a KV cache layout change that may need a quick migration. @liam if console toggles the new field, will it be behind a flag? We should gate it for at least a week.

liam: yeah we'll gate it. toggles: console feature flag 'meta_v2' off by default. config snippet:
```yaml
FEATURE_FLAGS:
  meta_v2: false
```
I'll flip in canary only.

sana: Review done on API PR, left minor comments on validation. Alex can you address them? After that I can approve and we can merge during the quiet window.

alex: Addressed comments and pushed. Also added SDK compatibility layer with fallback. SDK PR updated: tests passing locally. @sana please re-review when you get a chance.

sana: :thumbsup: re-reviewed and approved. Merging in 10m. @everyone expect staging deploy after merge, ping here when smoke green.

deploy-bot: merge detected: redwood-api#88 merged by sana at 1769123485. Starting staging deploy.

alex: Thanks. After smoke passes I'll merge SDK #420, then we can bump console. Liam, I'll tag you before console merge.

liam: Got it. Will watch the deploy. If any runtime helm values need change I can open PR: runtime/helm/values.yaml bump image tag + config.

alex: One more ask: runtime team please confirm no breaking kernel changes in v2.4.2 — @eng-runtime.

eng-runtime: Quick note: kernel paths unchanged; quant kernels updated but backward compatible. No migration needed.

alex: Great. Closing the loop: API merged, smoke tests passed, SDK merged, console PR queued. Thanks all :tada:
